title: Export selected authorized inventory-movement page to Excel
description: An inventory user downloads exactly the selected dynamic movement report page as xlsx, in chosen field order. Reuse ERP-130 authorized bounded preview and the existing ExcelExporter; recheck current-user stock-query menu and all filters on each download. Preserve base-unit labels and explicit unknown-history values, escape formula-leading text, never infer cost or aggregate unlike units. Existing HTTP audit records the read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify workbook tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses authorized bounded dynamic inventory preview, rechecks current-user stock-query permission and rejects invalid fields/filters/page size before returning bytes.
Workbook uses existing ExcelExporter for only the selected current page and column order, preserving base-unit and unknown-history evidence while escaping formula-leading text.
Designer offers xlsx download and visible empty/authorization errors; tests inspect selected columns, row cap, null/unknown values, formula safety and permission; document page limit.
